d: Serve as the analytical engine and administrative control point for autonomous vehicle fleet operations. The job holder converts operational data into actionable insight, tracks performance and compliance, supports workforce acquisition, and manages critical administrative workflows. The role equips the AV Fleet Manager with accurate information and disciplined controls to improve cost, efficiency, compliance and vehicle uptime.
Key Accountabilities Define 3 to 5 distinct outcome areas the role is accountable for (what, not how)

Lead daily AV testing and goods-transport operations in accordance with approved permits, SOPs and safety requirements. 2. Ensure vehicle, route, charging, staffing and technical readiness before deployment. 3. Monitor live operations and coordinate prompt response to incidents, breakdowns and service interruptions.
KPI (Qualitative): Safe deployment, service continuity and vehicle uptime achieved in line with approved targets.

Plan shifts, assign duties and supervise the autonomous testing team, including field personnel and supporting associates. 2. Coach the team, evaluate performance and coordinate required training and corrective actions. 3. Maintain compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, permits and operational controls.
KPI (Qualitative): Shift coverage and compliance actions on time.

Track operational KPIs, analyze trends and submit accurate daily, weekly and monthly reports. 2. Coordinate with JMSS functions, technology partners, vendors and authorities to resolve operational requirements. 3. Manage approved resources, vendor performance and improvement actions to enhance cost, efficiency and scalability.
KPI (Qualitative): Accurate reporting, timely action closure and controlled operating cost within approved budget
q: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations, Data Analytics, Fleet/Transport Management, Engineering or a related discipline
Minimum 2-4 years in fleet operations, operational analytics, compliance or administration,
Power BI/data analytics, project management, fleet management, quality or process-improvement certification is preferred
